entries.label: Moisture
entries.description: Air and ground moisture, 0 dry to 1 saturated.

entries.label: Pressure
entries.description: Normalised air pressure, 0 low to 1 high.

entries.label: Wind direction
entries.description: Wind direction in radians, counter-clockwise on screen. The sim wraps into [0, 2pi); the range here is the inclusive 2pi bound.

entries.label: Wind speed
entries.description: Normalised wind speed, 0 calm to 1 gale.

entries.label: Precipitation
entries.description: Precipitation falling this week, 0 none to 1 heaviest.

entries.label: Water to ground
entries.description: Water reaching the ground this week (rain plus melt); can exceed 1, capped at 2.

entries.label: Snow pack
entries.description: Accumulated snow, 0 none to 1 full pack.

entries.label: Pressure anomaly
entries.description: Signed local pressure anomaly added to the base pressure; clamped to plus or minus 0.5.
